title: Alien reproduction vehicle pilot and pilot manager at Edwards

tellings.quote: We have a whistleblower who's flown uh an alien reproduction vehicle, a UFO that we've seen. And more importantly, the man who managed all the pilots who flew them out of Edwards Air Force Base Edwards complex.

plain: The United States has built and flown its own copies of alien craft, which some call alien reproduction vehicles, out of Edwards Air Force Base in California. Steven Greer, who gathers UFO whistleblowers, tells Michels that he has a whistleblower who flew one, and, "more importantly," the man who managed all the pilots who flew them there. If true, it would mean humans are already flying craft copied from alien ones.
